title: December, 2007
logline: Does Chloe come home. No email. No card. The strip draws the mailbox for four panels.

panels.composition: The mailbox at the alley's mouth. WOOD opening it. Empty. BARNABY.

image.prompt: a young man opening a roadside mailbox at the mouth of a gravel alley and finding it empty, a small dog beside him, December, muddy watercolor

panels.composition: The monitor in the garage. Inbox: a ringtone company. Nothing else.
props: monitor: an inbox with one corporate email

image.prompt: close-up of a monitor showing an email inbox with a single corporate message and nothing else

panels.composition: The mailbox again, next day. Empty.

image.prompt: the same young man checking the same empty mailbox the next day, a dog waiting, no words

panels.composition: Christmas Eve. The mailbox. Wood not opening it. Walking past it with the dog toward the beach. The strip stops checking.

image.prompt: a young man and a dog walking past a closed roadside mailbox without stopping, toward a beach, December, watercolor, no words

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: Nothing comes. The strip stops checking on Christmas Eve. Julian: later.
